leadText: Alex Haynes is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Alex Haynes is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Haynes was born in Manhattan, a borough in New York City, New York. He joined the during , where he gained several roles, most notably that of Ash's Talonflame and other members of the same species. Haynes left the series towards the end of , having returned to voice a Talonflame and during the Manalo Conference.
